title: Application to Student Visa Process Steps for Hungary

processSteps.label: University Application : Stipendium Hungaricum or self-funded route
bullets: Stipendium Hungaricum (SH): apply via Tempus Foundation portal — fully-funded (no application fee)
Self-funded: apply directly at ELTE, Corvinus, BME, Debrecen — fee €100–€150 per university

processSteps.label: Admission / Scholarship Letter
bullets: SH scholars: scholarship contract from Tempus — tuition waived; health insurance included
Self-funded: Acceptance Letter + tuition €1,500–€8,000/year; health insurance ~€100–€300/year

processSteps.label: Financial Proof : bank statement showing sufficient funds
bullets: SH scholars: scholarship covers costs — bank statement still strengthens the file
Self-funded: ~€3,600–€6,000 recommended (min €300/month for the study period)

processSteps.label: Student Visa (National D) : Hungarian Embassy Dhaka or VFS Global
bullets: Hungary has an Embassy in Dhaka — apply directly or via VFS Global Dhaka

processSteps.label: Arrive Hungary — Register at OIF (Immigration Police)
bullets: Register within 30 days at local Office of Immigration and Nationality (OIF)
Obtain address card (lakcímkártya) — needed for bank account and university registration

processSteps.label: Residence Permit : apply before student visa expires
bullets: Submit at OIF before initial visa expires — fee: ~€25–€40
Valid for duration of studies; renew each academic year

costSteps.label: Air Ticket to Hungary : varies by season and route
